response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT s.riskeval, SUM(sc.gbsize) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(sc.spanmin), 0) AS rate FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref WHERE sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.riskeval), b AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS bm FROM g WHERE rate IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(g.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(g.rate - b.bm) AS avg_margin_above_benchmark FROM g CROSS JOIN b WHERE g.rate > b.bm

assumptions.assumption: A group's rate is total gbsize divided by total spanmin (a pooled ratio), not an average of per-scan ratios.
Scans that match a site means an inner join of scans.zoneref to sites.zoneregistry. A NULL riskeval is its own group.
Scans with a NULL gbsize or spanmin are excluded. Groups whose total duration is 0 have no rate and are left out of the benchmark.
The benchmark is the plain average of the group rates, with each group counted once. Only groups strictly above it are kept. If none qualify, the result row has NULLs.

alternatives.interpretation: Each group's rate is the average of the per-scan gbsize/spanmin ratios, not a pooled ratio.
alternatives.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT s.riskeval, AVG(sc.gbsize * 1.0 / sc.spanmin) AS rate FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref WHERE sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin <> 0 GROUP BY s.riskeval), b AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS bm FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(g.rate - b.bm) AS avg_margin_above_benchmark FROM g CROSS JOIN b WHERE g.rate > b.bm
